development_retrieval.limitation: Small local regression set; retrieval hits and citation checks do not establish answer correctness. Live answers require human review.

benchmark_maintenance: Three historical fee questions now explicitly request Fall 2025, distinct from newly crawled Fall 2026 fees.
MPhil requirements accept the current official clean URL and 4-year BS wording.
Programme duration labels now include the current official academics page; MS Data Science duration is explicitly published there.

candidate_evaluation.limitation: Pending examples are diagnostics. Answer accuracy, entailment and refusal quality require human review. ROUGE-L measures wording overlap only.

limitations: The 150 candidates have zero approved ground-truth labels. No production factual accuracy or groundedness score is claimed.
The department establishment-year regression lacks expected evidence within the final top-six retrieved passages.
The multilingual encoder, generator quality and concurrent-user behavior need independent validation.
OCR extraction and structured table values need departmental review before operational use.
A complete approved prerequisite matrix, current operational policies and departmental FYP procedures remain data dependencies.
Crawl bounds, unavailable pages and unlinked resources prevent claims of complete site coverage.
The expanded corpus is staged; the active corpus was not replaced.
